# O.Canada.com

> > A Canadian lifestyle and news publication covering home design, energy efficiency, travel, books, sports, and regional industry developments.

O.Canada.com features content spanning lifestyle topics including the CHEO Dream of a Lifetime lottery homes designed by Minto, sustainable living through initiatives like Edmonton's Eco Solar Tour, Canadian children's literature, travel destinations with Canadian connections, and coverage of sports and commodities sectors across Canada.

## Key Topics

- CHEO Dream of a Lifetime lottery homes
- Minto home design
- Energy efficiency and home retrofits
- Eco Solar Tour (Edmonton)
- Sustainable living and solar energy
- Canadian children's books
- Interior design and home staging
- Ontario mining industry
- Louisiana-Canada travel connections
- British equestrian style
- Retirement planning
- Julie Morstad
- Tanya Collins
- Ralph Lauren design influence

## Home Design & Lifestyle

- [From light and airy to dark and classy](https://o.canada.com/life/from-light-and-airy-to-dark-and-classy): CHEO Dream of a Lifetime home features old luxury hotel design by Minto
- [What's it really like to have a highly energy efficient home?](https://o.canada.com/life/homes/whats-it-really-like-to-have-a-highly-energy-efficient-home): Edmonton's Eco Solar Tour connects homeowners with energy retrofit seekers

## Travel & Culture

- [Exploring Louisiana's soul food, music and the Canadian connection](https://o.canada.com/travel/exploring-louisianas-food-music-and-canadian-connection): Louisiana travel guide covering Cajun cuisine from New Orleans to Lafayette

## Books & Family

- [Books for Kids: Moments for family](https://o.canada.com/news/books-for-kids-moments-for-family): Canadian children's book reviews featuring Julie Morstad and Kyo Maclear

## Sports

- [More controversy with referees as Mexico defeats Cameroon at World Cup](https://o.canada.com/sports/more-controversy-with-referees-as-mexico-defeats-cameroon-1-0-at-world-cup): Mexico beats Cameroon 1-0 amid referee controversy at 2014 World Cup in Natal

## Industry & Commodities

- [Ontario: Proves bigger can be better](https://o.canada.com/commodities/mining/ontario?r): Detour Lake gold mine construction to become Canada's largest gold operation
